create.q: How do I create my site?
create.a: Go to Dashboard → Create, claim your perlink.to name and pick a template. You can change everything later.

room.q: How do I turn on the 3D world?
room.a: Open your site in the editor and switch on “3D room”. Then tap “Decorate your room” to furnish it and pick a land.

publish.a: Press Publish in the editor. Your site goes live at perlink.to/yourname straight away.

photos.q: Can I add my own photos?
photos.a: Yes. Add an image album block to your site, or place a picture frame in your 3D room and upload a photo.

phones.a: Yes. Sites are mobile-first, and the 3D world runs in the browser and adapts its quality to the device.

visitors.q: Can visitors still see a normal page?
visitors.a: Always. Visitors can switch from the 3D world to your 2D page with one tap.
